text: R package empirical (nonparametric) Item Response Theory analysis. Instead fitting parametric IRT model (1PL/2PL/3PL, GRM, etc.) assuming specific mathematical form item response function, irtempirical estimates item’s characteristic curve directly data: respondents grouped observed total (sum) score, probability endorsing response option simply proportion respondents score group . idea behind classic nonparametric IRT tools (e.g. Ramsay’s TestGraf / kernel-smoothed ICCs), traded lightweight, dependency-free implementation based binning + optional logistic smoothing. works dichotomous (0/1) polytomous (ordinal, e.g. Likert) items.

code: library(irtempirical)  sim_dichotomous <- data.frame(psych::sim.irt(   nvar = 10, n = 1000, low = -4, high = 4,   a = NULL, c = 0, z = 1, d = NULL, mu = 0, sd = 1,   mod = "logistic" )$items)  sim_polytomous <- data.frame(psych::sim.poly(   nvar = 10, n = 1000, low = -4, high = 4,   a = NULL, c = 0, z = 1, d = NULL, mu = 0, sd = 1,   cat = 5, mod = "logistic" )$items)  m1 <- irt_empirical_model(data = sim_dichotomous, items = NULL) m2 <- irt_empirical_model(data = sim_polytomous, items = NULL)  plot(m1, type = "ICC", xlim = c(-6, 6), item = "V2",      draw.logit_method = 0, add_score_axis = TRUE)  plot(m2, type = "ICC", xlim = c(-6, 6), item = "V2",      draw.logit_method = 0, add_score_axis = TRUE)

text: Given data.frame item responses (one column per item, one row per respondent): Total score & z-score axis. row sum score computed every respondent (sum_scores). mean/SD used convert every possible integer score observed range z-score — z-score axis (scores_axis / z_scores_axis) stands latent trait (theta) x-axis every plot. Per-item, per-option response vectors. item response option (1..max), three indicator vectors built: responses1: 1 respondents chose exactly option responses2: 1 respondents chose responses3: 1 respondents chose less option gets EmpiricalIRT object also records position option scale (1 = first/left, 2 = middle, 3 = last/right). Empirical probabilities. Respondents grouped exact total score. Within score group, proportion satisfy three response vectors becomes one point empirical curve (y1, y2, y3 — one probability per possible total score). y1 empirical item/option characteristic curve; y2/y3 describe much probability mass sits /option (used polytomous items smoothing thresholds). Point-wise Bernoulli “information” (p * (1 - p)) also stored per score group. Optional logistic smoothing (addlogit = TRUE). quasibinomial GLM (y ~ x) fit y1, y2, y3 z-score axis, giving smoothed curves logit1, logit2, logit3 can overlaid raw empirical points. Monotonicity. single monotonicity index per option computed average absolute Spearman correlation z-score axis y2/y3 (falling back correlation y1 one degenerate, e.g. zero). Well-behaved items show monotonically increasing/decreasing option curves along trait axis; index quick numeric check . result EmpiricalIRTModel object: holds original data, score/z-score axes, named list (irts) mapping item name list per-option EmpiricalIRT results.
Computes empirical IRT model described . Returns EmpiricalIRTModel (S4).
S4 plot method EmpiricalIRTModel. Draws empirical item/option characteristic curve(s) one item. option given, monotonicity index option printed plot’s top-right margin, along sample size.

EmpiricalIRT — one response option one item: empirical curve points (x, y1, y2, y3), fitted logit models (logit1/2/3), information, monotonicity. EmpiricalIRTModel — whole fitted model: original data, score/z-score axes, items, irts (item name → list EmpiricalIRT).

text: data data.frame item responses: one column per item, one row per respondent. Values must numeric (dichotomous 0/1 polytomous 1..k). Used compute total scores , per item, empirical response-option curves. items Character vector column names data include model. NULL (default), every column data used. addlogit Logical. TRUE (default), fit quasibinomial GLM (y ~ x, family = quasibinomial) three empirical curves (y1, y2, y3) z-score axis, smoothed curve can overlaid raw empirical points plotting. FALSE, curve fitting skipped resulting logit1/logit2/logit3 slots stay NULL.
